# Architecture, Review, and Planning Artifact Instructions
- Trace components and tasks to requirement IDs.
- Label technology choices as existing, approved, or proposed.
- Explain key alternatives and trade-offs for material decisions.
- Do not close unresolved business questions by inference.
- Task data consistency must address persistence, concurrency, and atomicity where relevant to the approved business semantics.
- Design review findings must include severity, evidence, impact, recommendation, and status.
- Plans must be dependency-ordered, testable, and identify blocked work.
- Preserve decision history when architecture is revised after review.
